LESSON: WEAVING CRAFT

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PAPER
Topic 5.1: Weaving CRAFT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Weaving CRAFT. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Weaving CRAFT

1. Underline two new ideas about Weaving CRAFT in the examples.

3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Weaving CRAFT.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.
